name: Healing A Broken Heart
overview: Scripture reveals that God intimately cares for those who are brokenhearted, drawing near to them and offering healing for their wounds. The Lord is portrayed as a shepherd who sustains and strengthens His people, even when their flesh and heart fail. Believers are encouraged to cast their burdens upon the Lord and to trust Him wholeheartedly rather than relying on their own understanding, knowing that He is their eternal portion and strength.
